==Usage==
Please include the language of the book cover in the template like this: <code><nowiki>{{Bookcover|</nowiki>{{Var|language}}}}</code>. For example, use <code><nowiki>{{Bookcover|English}}</nowiki></code> or <code><nowiki>{{Bookcover|Japanese}}</nowiki></code>, etc. for proper file categorization.

==Categorization==
The file will be placed in one of the following categories depending on the specified language:
*[[:Category:Australian book covers]]
*[[:Category:Brazilian book covers]]
*[[:Category:Bulgarian book covers]]
*[[:Category:Czech book covers]]
*[[:Category:Danish book covers]]
*[[:Category:Dutch book covers]]
*[[:Category:English book covers]]
*[[:Category:Finnish book covers]]
*[[:Category:French book covers]]
*[[:Category:German book covers]]
*[[:Category:Hebrew book covers]]
*[[:Category:Hungarian book covers]]
*[[:Category:Icelandic book covers]]
*[[:Category:Japanese book covers]]
*[[:Category:Polish book covers]]
*[[:Category:Romanian book covers]]
*[[:Category:Russian book covers]]
*[[:Category:Spanish book covers]]
*[[:Category:Turkish book covers]]
*[[:Category:United Kingdom book covers]]
If a language other than the ones above is specified, the file will be placed in [[:Category:Book covers]] by default. However, if the language field is omitted or left blank, the file will be placed in [[:Category:Uncategorized book covers]].
